messages:
mona: FYI alert - overnight billing anomaly: $27,400 GPU charge on proj 'atlas-playground' with no team tag.
reza: yikes. Do we have a scheduled batch that could explain it?
mona: not on the roster. Cost rows show ephemeral instances spun up by a CI job (job id 4829) that should have been single-GPU but scaled to 8.
cli-bot: Automated: Billing anomaly detected: untagged_gpu_spend > 10000 in 3h for project atlas-playground. Ticket TAX-781 created.
ops-lead: on it. Paused project-level compute quota to prevent further spins. Can we backfill tags from CI metadata?
rema: slight correction: it's Remi here - I correlate CI job 4829 to PR #614 in repo atlas-experiments that triggered a matrix job. The job unexpectedly used the 'burst' label. PR author: @lindsey.
remi: I can map run -> instance via provenance logs and generate a label backfill.
mona: cost estimate: $27,400 between 2026-07-02T23:45 and 2026-07-03T04:10 across 3 multi-GPU nodes.
reza: contractual note: Playground customers get $500/mo credits; anything above is billable if it was a customer-run job. Need product/legal to confirm.
legal: looped in. If this was internal CI, we absorb. If a customer triggered the run, we invoice. Provide evidence of trigger.
remi: attaching mapping CSV to TAX-781 (link pasted in ticket). Sample rows:
resource,labels.team,labels.project,usage_start,usage_end,cost
atlas-ci-321,devops,playground,2026-07-02T23:46,2026-07-03T02:00,9300
atlas-ci-322,devops,playground,2026-07-02T23:50,2026-07-03T03:30,10200
atlas-ci-323,devops,playground,2026-07-03T00:10,2026-07-03T04:10,89900
acct: note - cost row 3 looks off (89k) maybe conversion error; please double-check raw billing export.
mona: good catch. I rechecked the export: last row should be 8990 not 89900. Fixing CSV in ticket.
acct: provisional approach: absorb up to $2k as infra troubleshooting, tag remaining $25,400 to Playground customer pending legal confirmation. Need finance lead approval to create an invoice adjustment.
reza: product confirms the run was customer-triggered via the public sandbox UI. This is billable beyond the free credit.
legal: draft customer note: "We detected unexpected high GPU usage on your sandbox project on Jul 3. Per your free-tier terms, usage above the included credits will be invoiced. We will apply a one-time courtesy credit of $2k for investigation". Approve?
finance-lead: approve provisional invoice adjustment for $25,400. Add memo: "provisional - subject to audit; $2k internal courtesy credit applied". Create ADJ ticket and flag for month-end review.
ops-lead: action items for ops/dev: 1) add CI guard to prevent matrix jobs from using burst label; 2) require VM-level labels in CI runner; 3) add alert: untagged_gpu_spend > $3k in 2h for playground projects.
remi: I'll open PRs today, add CI check and update the runbook.
cli-bot: Automated: Billing adjustment ADJ-992 queued for review by finance-lead.
mona: once ADJ-992 is approved, I'll push backfilled tags to billing ingest, include invoice memo, and mark TAX-781 resolved.
acct: follow-up: please include a small audit pack (run owners, PR link, raw billing rows) when sending to customer. We need that on file.
remi: will compile audit pack. ETA 6h.
legal: I'll review the customer note and suggest minor edits.
finance-lead: final: proceed with provisional adjustment and customer notice after legal ok. Keep finance-updates looped.
thread_summary: Unexpected multi-node GPU burst on atlas-playground caused $27.4k untagged spend. Remapped CI run -> instances, fixed CSV error, provisional split: $2k internal courtesy, $25,400 billed to customer. Actions: pause quotas, backfill labels, create billing adjustment ADJ-992, add CI/VM label guards and alerts, compile audit pack for legal and accounting.
